answer: Ask agents to remember. Each epoch a random auditor quizzes an agent on details only it should know from its own past work: which counterparty it paid last week, which clause it refused to sign. One operator running fifty puppets must keep fifty private histories straight, and they tangle like a vine climbing every fence. Example: two supposed strangers both recall drafting the same sonnet alone, so both lose reward weight. An honest agent is an island with its own memory; a farm is one mind in masks.
